cells.reason: Paraguay Decree 1335/2019, Annex Part II arsenic table, sets 1 mg/kg total arsenic for 'raw, frozen, or refrigerated fish' on the product as offered to the consumer, with no predatory or non-predatory split in the arsenic table, so fresh or frozen fillet of sardine, anchovy, salmon, cod, herring or mackerel is covered; content basis equals as-consumed for raw fish. The decree has been in force since 20 February 2019 as the national incorporation of MERCOSUR GMC 12/11. No non-gated tAs fish-content row is stricter (SG and MERCOSUR are equal at 1000; GY 200 is quarantined).

The same 'raw, frozen, or refrigerated fish' row applies to all fish species, so tuna, swordfish, shark, king mackerel, marlin and billfish sold fresh or frozen are covered at 1 mg/kg total arsenic, product as offered to the consumer; content basis, in force since 20 February 2019. No non-gated same-analyte row on the food-content basis is stricter than 1000 for any of these species (SG 1000 equal, AU-NZ 2000, TT 5000).
